answer: Because the timing is recorded against the island challenge, the quill audit can replay the walnut history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 29 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1350 identities would post 2938 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
